unitTitle: An Early Bird or a Night Owl?

rule.titleUz: Takrorlanish ravishlari va ularning aniq o'rni
rule.explanationUz:
RAVISHLAR: always, usually, often, never, rarely, sometimes

Grammar Book qoidani Coursebook'dagidan ANIQROQ beradi —
UCHTA holat bor:

  1) ASOSIY fe'ldan OLDIN
     I NEVER get up early on Sundays.
     He RARELY goes to the zoo.
     She SOMETIMES has a sandwich for lunch.

  2) YORDAMCHI fe'ldan (do, does) KEYIN
     Do you OFTEN walk to work?

  3) 'to be' fe'lidan KEYIN
     Mum is USUALLY home by four.
     He is ALWAYS late for work.

OSON ESLAB QOLISH:
  Ravish DOIM birinchi fe'ldan keyin turadi —
  agar birinchi fe'l yordamchi yoki 'to be' bo'lsa.
  Agar bitta fe'l bo'lsa va u 'to be' bo'lmasa — ravish OLDIN.

rules.uzRule: Takrorlanish ravishlari ASOSIY fe'ldan OLDIN keladi.
rules.enRule: Adverbs of frequency usually come before the main verb.
examples: I never get up early on Sundays.
He rarely goes to the zoo. (= not often)
She sometimes has a sandwich for lunch.

rules.uzRule: LEKIN YORDAMCHI fe'ldan (do, does) KEYIN keladi.
rules.enRule: But they come after the auxiliary verb (do, does, etc).
examples: Do you often walk to work?

rules.uzRule: Va 'to be' fe'lidan ham KEYIN keladi.
rules.enRule: And after the verb to be.
examples: Mum is usually home by four.
He is always late for work.

rules.uzRule: Ular ish QANCHALIK TEZ-TEZ sodir bo'lishini aytadi.
rules.enRule: They tell us how often something happens.
examples: always 100% > usually 75% > often 50% > sometimes 25% > rarely 10% > never 0%

rule.warningUz:
'RARELY' = 'NOT OFTEN' — kitob buni alohida ta'kidlaydi.
  He rarely goes to the zoo. = He doesn't often go to the zoo.

'rarely' va 'never' O'ZLARI INKOR ma'nosini beradi —
qo'shimcha 'not' QO'SHILMAYDI:
  ✅ He rarely goes.     ❌ He doesn't rarely go.
  ✅ I never get up early. ❌ I don't never get up early.
rule.noteUz:
SAVOLDA ravish qayerda turadi:
  Do you OFTEN walk to work?
   ↑    ↑     ↑
  yordamchi ega ravish

Ya'ni: Do + EGA + RAVISH + asosiy fe'l?

INKORDA:
  I don't USUALLY get up early.
  ('don't' — yordamchi, ravish undan keyin)
rule.extraUz:
'BY' + vaqt — qiziq qo'llanish:
  Mum is usually home BY four.
  = Onam odatda soat to'rtgacha uyda bo'ladi.

  'by four' = to'rtgacha (to'rtdan kech emas)
  'at four' = aynan soat to'rtda
  'until four' = to'rtgacha (davomiylik)

Farqni ko'ring:
  I'll be home BY six.    — oltigacha (balki beshda ham)
  I'll be home AT six.    — aynan oltida

exercises.instructionEn: Put the words into the correct order to form sentences, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: So'zlarni to'g'ri tartibga qo'yib, gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
SO'Z TARTIBI QOIDASI:

  EGA + (RAVISH) + FE'L + TO'LDIRUVCHI + JOY + VAQT

NAMUNA:
  at / the morning / he / seven o'clock / in / gets up
  → He gets up at seven o'clock in the morning.
     ↑    ↑        ↑                ↑
    ega  fe'l    aniq vaqt      umumiy vaqt

VAQT IFODALARI TARTIBI: ANIQDAN UMUMIYGA
  at seven o'clock (aniq) → in the morning (umumiy)
  ✅ at seven o'clock in the morning
  ❌ in the morning at seven o'clock

RAVISH QAYERDA:
  oddiy fe'l bilan → fe'ldan OLDIN
  'to be' bilan    → fe'ldan KEYIN

items.answer: He gets up at seven o'clock in the morning.
items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Ega + fe'l + aniq vaqt + umumiy vaqt.
'often' — oddiy fe'l 'washes' dan OLDIN. Ega + ravish + fe'l + to'ldiruvchi.
'was born' = tug'ilgan. Yil bilan IN predlogi.

items.answer: I rarely have breakfast in the morning.
items.whyUz: 'rarely' — fe'l 'have' dan OLDIN. 'in the morning' gap oxirida.

items.answer: What time do you leave for work?
items.whyUz: So'roq so'zi ('What time') eng oldinda, keyin yordamchi 'do', keyin ega. 'leave FOR work' — ishga ketmoq.

items.answer: She never goes to bed early.
items.whyUz: 'never' — fe'l 'goes' dan OLDIN. 'go to bed' — 'the' YO'Q. 'early' gap oxirida.

exercises.instructionEn: What do you usually/never/always/often/sometimes/rarely do on Mondays? Choose from the list, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Dushanba kunlari odatda / hech qachon / doim / tez-tez / ba'zan / kamdan-kam nima qilasiz? Ro'yxatdan tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (8 ta ibora):
  get up early         — erta turmoq
  clean my room        — xonamni tozalamoq
  play football        — futbol o'ynamoq
  go for a walk        — sayrga chiqmoq
  go to school         — maktabga bormoq
  watch TV             — televizor ko'rmoq
  play computer games  — kompyuter o'yini o'ynamoq
  go out with friends  — do'stlar bilan sayrga chiqmoq

NAMUNA:
  I USUALLY get up early on Mondays.

QOLIP:
  I + RAVISH + fe'l + ON MONDAYS.

DIQQAT:
  'on Mondays' — KO'PLIKDA, 'har dushanba' degani
  'I' bilan fe'l -s OLMAYDI (get, play, watch — s siz)
  ravish fe'ldan OLDIN turadi

example.speaker: namuna
example.en: I usually get up early on Mondays.

modelSentences.sentence: I rarely clean my room on Mondays.
I often play football on Mondays.
I sometimes go for a walk on Mondays.
I always go to school on Mondays.
I usually watch TV on Mondays.
I sometimes play computer games on Mondays.
modelSentences.uz: Dushanba kunlari ba'zan kompyuter o'yini o'ynayman.

modelSentences.sentence: I never go out with friends on Mondays.
modelSentences.uz: Dushanba kunlari hech qachon do'stlar bilan sayrga chiqmayman.

sections.title: Prepositions of Time: at, in, on

rule.titleUz: AT / IN / ON — to'liq qoida va misollar
rule.explanationUz:
UCHTA PREDLOG, har biri o'z guruhiga ega.

OSON ESLAB QOLISH — ANIQLIKDAN UMUMIYLIKKA:

  AT → eng ANIQ nuqta (soat)
  ON → bir KUN
  IN → uzun DAVR (oy, fasl, yil)

Kichikdan kattaga: AT < ON < IN
  at three o'clock  <  on Saturday  <  in August  <  in 1959

table.subject: AT
table.full: at three o'clock, at the weekend, at night, at noon

table.subject: IN
table.full: in August, in the autumn, in 1959, in the evening

table.subject: ON
table.full: on Saturday, on Sunday mornings, on Friday the 2nd of August

keyRules.uzRule: AT — soat bilan va 'the weekend', 'night', 'noon' bilan.
keyRules.enRule: We use at with time and with the weekend, night and noon.
examples: The match starts at three o'clock.
We often visit our grandparents at the weekend.

keyRules.uzRule: IN — oy, fasl, yil bilan va 'the morning / the evening / the afternoon' iboralari bilan.
keyRules.enRule: We use in with months, seasons, years and with the expressions the morning/the evening/the afternoon.
examples: They go on holiday in August.
He always watches TV in the evening.

keyRules.uzRule: ON — hafta kunlari, ANIQ kunning qismlari va sanalar bilan.
keyRules.enRule: We use on with days of the week, parts of a particular day and dates.
examples: Mum always makes us a special breakfast on Sunday mornings.
She was born on Friday the 2nd of August in 1991.

rule.warningUz:
KITOBDAGI YULDUZCHALI ESLATMA:
  'We write months and days of the week with a CAPITAL LETTER.'

  ✅ August, Saturday, Sunday, March
  ❌ august, saturday, sunday, march

Bu o'zbek tilida yo'q qoida — shuning uchun eng ko'p unutiladi.

DIQQAT: FASLLAR kichik harf bilan yoziladi!
  ✅ in the autumn, in summer, in spring
  (oylar va kunlar — katta harf, fasllar — kichik)
rule.noteUz:
ENG CHALKASH JOY — 'morning/evening/afternoon':

  IN the morning        — umuman ertalab
  ON Sunday mornings    — yakshanba ertalablari (kun NOMI bor!)
  ON Friday evening     — juma kechqurun

QOIDA: kun nomi bo'lsa → ON, bo'lmasa → IN.

Va 'night' butunlay boshqacha:
  at night   (in the night EMAS)
  on Friday night (kun nomi bor → ON)
rule.extraUz:
TO'LIQ SANADA IKKI PREDLOG:
  She was born ON Friday the 2nd of August IN 1991.
                ↑ kun va sana              ↑ yil

Ya'ni kun-sana uchun ON, yil uchun IN — bir gapda ikkalasi.

SANA O'QILISHI:
  Friday the 2nd of August
  = 'Friday the second of August'
  ('the' va 'of' SHART)

exercises.instructionUz: at, in yoki on — birini tanlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
Kitobdagi barcha misollarni mashq qiling.
Har birida NIMA turganiga qarang: soat, kun, oy, fasl, yil?

items.textEn: We often visit our grandparents ____ the weekend.

items.whyUz: Oy → IN. 'go on holiday' = ta'tilga chiqmoq.

items.textEn: He always watches TV ____ the evening.
Mum always makes us a special breakfast ____ Sunday mornings.
items.whyUz: Kun NOMI bor ('Sunday') → ON. 'in the mornings' bo'lardi, lekin bu yerda kun aytilgan.

items.textEn: She was born ____ Friday the 2nd of August ...
She was born on Friday the 2nd of August ____ 1991.
items.whyUz: Yil → IN. Bir gapda ikkala predlog: ON (sana) va IN (yil).

exercises.instructionEn: Note: We write months and days of the week with a capital letter.
exercises.instructionUz: Eslatma: oylar va hafta kunlari KATTA harf bilan yoziladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
KATTA HARF QOIDASI (kitobdagi yulduzchali eslatma):

  KATTA harf bilan:
    oylar:       January, February, March, ...
    hafta kunlari: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, ...
    millat:      English, Uzbek, Spanish
    mamlakat:    England, Uzbekistan
    tillar:      English, Uzbek

  KICHIK harf bilan:
    fasllar:     spring, summer, autumn, winter
    kun qismlari: morning, afternoon, evening, night

Bu farqni yodda tuting — fasllar KATTA harf bilan YOZILMAYDI!

items.whyUz: Fasllar KICHIK harf bilan — bu oylardan farqli!

items.textEn: Kun qismini to'g'ri yozing: the Evening →

wordFormation.introUz: Grammar Book 22-bet — ravishlar va vaqt iboralari.

groups.explanationUz: Ravish qaysi fe'ldan oldin yoki keyin turishini gapning tuzilishi belgilaydi.
Bir xil ma'noni ikki xil aytish. 'rarely' qisqaroq va rasmiyroq.
Ingliz tilida qaysi so'zlar katta harf bilan yozilishini bilish kerak.
Ikkalasi ham vaqt bilan, lekin ma'nosi boshqa.
Bir gapda bir necha vaqt ifodasi bo'lsa, ANIQDAN UMUMIYGA tartiblanadi.

items.note: at 7 in the morning on Monday in August

patterns.exampleEn: I never get up early on Sundays. Bob often washes the car.
patterns.exampleUz: Yakshanba kunlari hech qachon erta turmayman. Bob tez-tez mashina yuvadi.
patterns.explanationUz: Oddiy fe'l bilan ravish OLDIN turadi.

patterns.exampleEn: Do you often walk to work?
patterns.explanationUz: Savolda ravish yordamchi fe'ldan KEYIN, asosiy fe'ldan OLDIN turadi.

patterns.exampleEn: Mum is usually home by four. He is always late for work.
patterns.exampleUz: Onam odatda to'rtgacha uyda bo'ladi. U ishga doim kechikadi.

patterns.formula: EGA + fe'l + AT + aniq vaqt + IN + kun qismi.
patterns.exampleEn: He gets up at seven o'clock in the morning.

patterns.formula: EGA + was born + IN + yil / ON + sana.
patterns.exampleEn: Jane was born in 1964. She was born on Friday the 2nd of August in 1991.
patterns.exampleUz: Jeyn 1964-yilda tug'ilgan. U 1991-yil 2-avgust, juma kuni tug'ilgan.
patterns.explanationUz: Yil bilan IN, kun-sana bilan ON. Bir gapda ikkalasi bo'lishi mumkin.

patterns.exampleEn: What time do you leave for work?
patterns.explanationUz:
So'roq so'zi eng oldinda, keyin yordamchi 'do', keyin ega.
'leave FOR work' — 'for' bilan yo'nalish.
